settings.heading: Kansa
settings.subheading: Pick the pan in your hand. Type a question, or use the microphone where supported.

settings.heading: Ask what’s on your mind
settings.text: Will it work on induction? Does it need seasoning? How do I clean it? Start with the model and ask in your own words.

settings.heading: Where the answer comes from
settings.text: Kansa, named for bell metal, is a prototype. It uses prepared guidance and the catalogue. Check the status of any design target. You can also use the written care guide.

settings.heading: Designed to travel with the pan
settings.text:
Boxes go missing. Pans turn up years later. We’re exploring a code on the vessel or care card to help the next cook find its record.
